integrity: Analytical all-parameter proof and reproducible symbolic/numerical diagnostic included. Numerical samples are supplementary and are not treated as proof of strict monotonicity or as independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Real affine L2 projection for normalized uniform area on concentric planar annuli only; no higher-degree, complex, irregular or boundary-arclength extension. The a=1 formula is a thin-ring limit, not an area annulus.
title: Strict annular-hole monotonicity for sharp affine least-squares projection
